stem_book: Classify the following as physical or chemical equilibrium: (i) H₂O(s) ⇌ H₂O(l) (ii) NH₄Cl(s) ⇌ NH₄Cl(l) (iii) H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g) (iv) CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g)
reason: Quick-recap table, four parts with separate answers. Printed key also wrong on (iv): says physical, but CaCO₃ -> CaO + CO₂ is a chemical change (book's own Example-1(e) says chemical).
work: (iv) new substances CaO, CO₂ formed -> chemical (heterogeneous) equilibrium.
